cases.case: a coding Lead hook ask offers once / this session / always, keyed by the tool
"always" saves one every-agent grant: no card for that tool in this or any other conversation
the answered call keeps a hook rewrite and is not marked as an outbound approval
"this session" covers the tool for that conversation only, ends on reset and after 12 h, never saved
the key is the tool (or the classified kind), never the arguments: nothing widens to an unrelated call
tools that change what agents may do, and the user prompts, are asked once
payments and permanent deletes are never offered, stored or honoured, and are not skipped by Allow all actions
a grant for one kind or tool never answers a payment, a delete or another kind
an unattended run never gets or uses a session grant; it may use a saved always grant
